task.description:
Execute the test suites for OIDC-11 through OIDC-15.

Run:
1. zig build test (unit tests) - must exit 0
2. zig build test-integration (with BPM_TEST_DB_URL set) - must exit 0

Collect results and write a structured test report to tests/reports/.
Capture all failures with severity classification (BLOCKER, MAJOR, MINOR).
acceptance_criteria: Test report written to tests/reports/ with all results captured

result.summary: Integration tests failed: 2 BLOCKER failures (TC-OIDC-11-08 RealmOwnershipMismatch, TC-OIDC-15-07 ServerError) and 15 memory leaks in insertDeletionTracker. Unit tests passed (0 failures).

issues.description: RealmOwnershipMismatch: createOrGetJitOidcUser failed asserting realm kc-oidc11-08 is owned by tenant. The realm binding setup may be incomplete in the test fixture.
PgError.ServerError: markUsersInactiveByRealm SQL query failed with PostgreSQL server error.

15 memory leaks across 5 tests: all stem from std.fmt.allocPrint in insertDeletionTracker (realm_deletion.zig:229-230) where allocPrint results for grace_period_seconds and hard_delete_after are never freed.
